evidence.detail: The already-reviewed R344 TitlePaneControlPanel rs/gui/O constructs exactly one rs/gui/P in its constructor and installs it directly with JPanel.setLayout; no other exact-v308 owner constructs this layout manager.

rs/gui/P implements LayoutManager2 and sizes the parent from componentCount*27 by 23, then lays out every child horizontally with a 4px lead gap, 23px cell width and vertically centered height capped at 23px.
R344 fixes the parent rs/gui/O as the Substance title-pane trailing control panel that owns the hide/show-side-panel button, so this layout's scope is specifically that title-pane control surface.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 Swing role paired directly with R344 TitlePaneControlPanel; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
